fees.notes: Official OUM International Learner Fees for this programme: RM27,930 total (subject fees only; excludes one-off registration fee of RM4,150, processing and resource fees; 6% SST applies to international and Permanent Resident students from 1 July 2025; 60% of the semester fee is due before the semester starts and 40% before examination week). Source: https://www.oum.edu.my/programmes-offered-at-oum/postgraduate/master-of-english-studies/ (accessed 2026-09-18). per_year = total / 20 months x 12. Note: the programme is not listed in OUM's International Admission programme table (https://www.oum.edu.my/international-admission/).

requirements.other_qualifications: Bachelor degree with minimum 2nd Class Lower
